Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Description:
Find the plugin you want without hunting through repository lists. Omega brings official and community Dalamud plugins into one searchable storefront with Spotlight, screenshots, tags, compatibility, source choice, and security insights.

Use /omega or /omg to open Omega, compare repositories, inspect plugin security information, install through Dalamud, and keep your Library and Updates together.
Changelog: Security Evidence v2 production cutover release-gate repair: the per-batch production-security-v2-report.json is now retained explicitly as a named workflow artifact, preserving the auditable batch-summary contract.
